application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Demolition of existing single storey garage and erection of double storey side extension to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (3433/SD101, design and access statement, construction traffic management plan- received 12/07/2021
3433/SD102, 3433/SD103, 3433/SD104, 3433/SD105, 3433/SD106, 3433/SD107, 3433/SD108, 3433/SD109, 3433/SD110, 3433/SD111- received 27/07/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
